text: The landscape with its coverage matrix, the object canvas with the ruler and its receipt, the inspector and the command line.
The Work ledger: one row per failing record and field, the record inspector, bulk decisions, fill down, the fix sheet round trip and undo.
Object tabs for rules, records, runs and readiness, and the rule canvas and inspector with definition, failing records, impact and history.
The run timeline, the Run and Compare canvases that explain why each score moved, the job line and the system inspector.
Approvals, exceptions and write-backs in the ledger, the batch and person inspectors, the People canvas and the inbox with triage.
The Golden records, Glossary, Lineage and Processes tabs of every object, with their inspectors.
Administration, preferences, the help panel, reports and their schedules, and migration waves.
The system canvas with configuration, schedules and custom objects, connection and scope editors, the rules library, the survivorship editor and the process designer.

Every role's verbs: comments and mentions, watch, out of office, escalation chain, contracts, balance work, wave gates, dry run and changes only, what-if, share links, view as, configuration bundle, bulk rules and the stewardship template.
The map, canvas and inspector are the whole product. Every older address opens the place that does the same job; wave sign-off and file upload live in the waves panel and Administration.

Policy packs with a policy mark on scores, scheduled digests, sandbox mode, record history and the ledger as of a run, run duration and cost before you start, and questions in plain words with ? in the command line.

A home for SAP Basis, the measured score beside a capped one, money marked as an estimate, a confirmation over 25 rows, object tabs under the title, the Unassigned row on People and clearer Administration names.
